heroDescription: Master modern biological concepts across human reproduction, molecular genetics, applied biotechnology, and ecological conservation with high-yield NEET blueprints.

units.title: Reproduction
units.description: In-depth exploration of human reproductive anatomy, hormonal regulation, menstrual cycle, fertilization, embryonic development, contraceptive mechanisms, and reproductive health standards.

chapters.title: Chemical Coordination and Integration
chapters.description: Endocrine glands and hormones, pituitary-gonadal axis, hormonal control of gametogenesis, feedback loops, and secondary sexual characteristics.

chapters.title: Human Reproduction
chapters.description: Male and female reproductive systems, spermatogenesis, oogenesis, menstrual cycle, fertilization, blastocyst formation, implantation, pregnancy, and parturition.

chapters.title: Reproductive Health
chapters.description: Need for reproductive health, prevention of sexually transmitted diseases (STDs), birth control methods, medical termination of pregnancy (MTP), amniocentesis, and ART (IVF, ZIFT, GIFT).

units.title: Genetics and Evolution
units.tagline: Mendelian Inheritance, Molecular DNA Mechanisms & Evolutionary Divergence
units.description: The core foundational pillar of modern biology covering Mendelian genetics, chromosomal theory, DNA replication, transcription, genetic code, translation, human genome project, and evolutionary mechanisms.

chapters.title: Principles of Inheritance and Variation
chapters.description: Mendelian laws of inheritance, incomplete dominance, co-dominance, multiple alleles, pleiotropy, polygenic inheritance, chromosome theory, sex determination, and genetic disorders (Down, Turner, Klinefelter, Hemophilia).

chapters.title: Molecular Basis of Inheritance
chapters.description: DNA structure and packaging, search for genetic material (Griffith, Hershey-Chase), semiconservative replication (Meselson-Stahl), transcription, genetic code, translation, lac operon regulation, and Human Genome Project.
keyTopics: Lac Operon Model & Human Genome Project

chapters.title: Evolution
chapters.description: Origin of life, biological evolution and evidences (homologous vs analogous organs, embryological, paleontological), Darwinian natural selection, Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium, and human evolutionary ancestry.
keyTopics: Stages of Human Evolution (Australopithecus to Homo sapiens)

units.title: Biology in Human Welfare
units.tagline: Pathology, Immunology, Microbial Industrial Biotechnology & Bio-agents
units.description: Immune defense mechanisms, infectious pathogens (Malaria, Typhoid, HIV/AIDS, Cancer), drug abuse, and the utilization of microbes in household products, industrial fermentation, sewage treatment, biogas, and biocontrol.

chapters.title: Human Health and Disease
chapters.description: Pathogens causing human diseases (Typhoid, Pneumonia, Malaria, Filariasis, Ringworm), innate and acquired immunity, antibodies, allergy, autoimmunity, AIDS pathogenesis, Cancer biology, and drug/alcohol abuse.
keyTopics: Innate vs Acquired Immunity & Antibodies (IgA, IgG, IgM)
HIV Life Cycle & ELISA / Western Blot

chapters.title: Microbes in Human Welfare
chapters.description: Microbes in household food processing (LAB, Baker's yeast), industrial products (fermented beverages, antibiotics, bioactive molecules: Cyclosporin A, Statins), biological sewage treatment (STP), biogas generation, and biofertilizers.

units.title: Biotechnology and its Applications
units.tagline: Recombinant DNA Tools, Genetic Engineering & Transgenic Bio-Solutions
units.description: Genetic engineering techniques, restriction endonucleases, cloning vectors (pBR322), PCR amplification, bioreactors, Bt crops, RNA interference (RNAi), gene therapy, and bioethics.

chapters.title: Biotechnology: Principles and Processes
chapters.description: Recombinant DNA technology tools: Restriction enzymes (EcoRI), ligases, selectable markers, cloning vectors, PCR thermal cycles, insertion into host, and downstream processing in stirred-tank bioreactors.
keyTopics: Cloning Vector Anatomy (pBR322, ori, rop, ampR, tetR)

chapters.title: Biotechnology and its Applications
chapters.description: Applications in agriculture (Bt Cotton, RNAi against Meloidegyne incognita), medicine (Genetically engineered insulin, ADA deficiency gene therapy), molecular diagnostics (ELISA, PCR), transgenic animals, and ethical issues.
keyTopics: Recombinant Human Insulin (Humulin) & ADA Gene Therapy

units.title: Ecology and Environment
units.tagline: Population Dynamics, Ecosystem Energetics & Global Biodiversity Conservation
units.description: Organism and environmental adaptations, population attributes and growth models, ecosystem trophic structures and nutrient cycles, biodiversity gradients, extinction causes, and biosphere reserves.

chapters.title: Organisms and Populations
chapters.description: Abiotic factors, adaptations, population attributes (birth rate, death rate, age pyramids), population growth models (exponential vs logistic), and interspecific population interactions (mutualism, predation, parasitism).

chapters.title: Ecosystem
chapters.description: Structure and function of ecosystem, productivity (GPP, NPP), decomposition dynamics, energy flow (10% law), ecological pyramids (number, biomass, energy), and ecological succession.

chapters.title: Biodiversity and Conservation
chapters.description: Patterns of biodiversity (latitudinal gradients, species-area relationship), importance of biodiversity (Rivet popper hypothesis), causes of biodiversity loss (The Evil Quartet), and In-situ vs Ex-situ conservation strategies.
keyTopics: The Evil Quartet (Habitat Loss, Over-exploitation, Alien Species, Co-extinctions)
In-Situ Conservation (National Parks, Sanctuaries, Biosphere Reserves)
Ex-Situ Conservation (Botanical Gardens, Cryopreservation, Gene Banks)
